حَارِدٌ : see حَرِيدٌ. ＝
-A2- Also, (S, A, K,) and ↓ حَرِدٌ (A, K) and ↓ حَرْدَانُ , Angry: (S, A, K:) exasperated (مُتَحَرِّشٌ) by him who has angered him, and desirous of killing him: (T, L:) or the first, compact in make, strong, feared, or dreaded; whom, by reason of [his] disdainfulness (عزة [i. e. عِزَّة]) one thinks to be angry. (Ham p. 300.) أَسَدٌ حَارِدٌ An angry lion: pl. حَوَارِدُ. (S, A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
